note: Maps every string WP-71 puts on the site (the brand story page, the brand kit page and the brand kit link on the press page) to the existing page and line, token line or claim id it restates. The brand story invents no history, date, name or statistic: each sentence is moved from src/content/pages/about/index.md, manifesto.md, editorial-policy.md, .astro-magazine/decisions.md (D-8) or src/pages/press/index.astro. tests/unit/wp-71/story-sources.test.ts enumerates the strings from the page files, fails on one that is not listed here, fails on a stale entry, checks each quote against its file, and runs the claims denylist over all of them. A "ui_label" entry is a heading, table header or control label that states no fact about WE. A "page_frame" entry describes the page itself and states no fact about WE; the test caps how many there may be and rejects digits and fact verbs in them. A "paraphrase" entry names the line it restates and says what changed. The press boilerplate was moved verbatim from src/pages/press/index.astro into src/pages/press/_boilerplate.ts so /press/ and the brand kit state the same text. The ORBITAL registry was not fetched for this package (gh was not authenticated in the build environment); no sentence depends on it.
